projectDescription: Readyt is an AI-powered Reddit marketing platform that helps SaaS teams generate leads, earn SEO backlinks, and build AI search (GEO) visibility through automated replies, posts, and analytics.
keyFeatures: AI Reply Engine — scans Reddit in real time, scores threads by buyer intent, drafts human-sounding replies for one-click approval
Post Generator — creates native Reddit posts in your brand voice, queued at peak hours across subreddits
Analytics Dashboard — tracks AI citations (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini), backlinks, and Reddit mentions in one place
Account Warming (ReadytWarm) — auto-warms aged Reddit accounts to build karma and prevent bans
Anti-Ban Engine — warmed accounts, health scoring, and human-like activity patterns
MCP Integration — connect Readyt data to Claude, Cursor, n8n, and other AI tools
Intent Scoring — LLM pipeline ranks every Reddit thread by buyer intent so you engage only high-value threads
Auto DMs — automated direct messages to qualified Reddit leads
3-in-1 Channel — one workflow drives Reddit leads, Google backlinks, and AI search visibility simultaneously
publicApiSurface: MCP server — query brand visibility, citations, and competitor data from Claude or Cursor
API — build custom workflows with AI visibility data
AI Reply Engine — one-click reply approval flow
Post Generator — schedule posts across subreddits
Analytics — filter by AI model, region, and audience segment
Competitor tracking — track up to 4–unlimited competitor brands
Auto DM — configure daily outreach volume per plan
